title: Page
description: A UI page belonging to a Project (BE-02). Project 1—N Page; Page 1—N Component; Page 1—N APIBinding (T-12). Audit fields optional — JPA Auditing on GsuifPage (STD-24, BE-08).

id.description: UUID identifier (ADR-005, STD-35). Server-generated on create.

route.description: Optional relative UI route, e.g. /work-orders (T-12). Not an environment URL.

apiBindings.description: API bindings on this page (T-12 required).

relationships.description: Reusable entity relationships for this page (one-to-many / many-to-many). Optional; simple CRUD pages omit it.

createdAt.description: JSON/JPA property createdAt (T-12, AuditableEntity). Filled by @CreatedDate (STD-24). Not client-supplied on create.

updatedAt.description: JSON/JPA property updatedAt (T-12, AuditableEntity). Filled by @LastModifiedDate (STD-24). Not client-supplied on create.

createdBy.description: Username from AuditorAware / JWT (STD-23). Not client-supplied on create.

lastModifiedBy.description: Username from AuditorAware (STD-23, STD-24). Not client-supplied on create.
